title: Deployability Aspects of AI
standfirst: What it takes to put an AI system into production — latency, cost, robustness, monitoring and rollback.

description_paragraphs: The success of machine learning and deep learning models in laboratory settings often does not translate to real-world deployment. This course introduces the key challenges involved in deploying ML systems, including explainability, fairness, privacy, and security, with a focus on understanding these issues from an algorithmic and statistical perspective.
